3502.title: Ice Cave in Paradana
3502.summary: The Great Ice Cave in Paradana is one of Slovenia's deepest and best-known caves, with a history of ice being cut, removed and sold in the late 19th century. Today…

content.source: Velika ledenica v Paradani je ena izmed najglobljih in najbolj znanih jam v Sloveniji, že zaradi njene zgodovine, ko so ob koncu 19. stoletja iz jame izrezovali, odvažali in prodajali kose ledu iz jame. V današnjem času je pa prepoznana kot naravni spomenik, predvsem zaradi trajne prisotnosti ledu v jami.
content.translation: The Great Ice Cave in Paradana is one of the deepest and best-known caves in Slovenia, partly because of its history: at the end of the 19th century, blocks of ice were cut from the cave, hauled away and sold. Today it is recognised as a natural monument, primarily because of the permanent presence of ice in the cave.

content.source: V času prvih raziskav je led segal do globine 150 metrov, zaradi temperaturnih sprememb pa se ta vedno hitreje tali. S takim tempom morda v nekaj desetletjih ledu v jami sploh ne bo več.
content.translation: At the time of the first explorations, the ice extended to a depth of 150 metres, but temperature changes are causing it to melt ever faster. At this rate, there may be no ice left in the cave at all in a few decades.

content.source: Na fotografijah je prikazana dvorana precej blizu vhoda (na globini cca 20 metrov).
content.translation: The photographs show a chamber quite close to the entrance (at a depth of approximately 20 metres).

3481.title: Comet Tsuchinshan-ATLAS (C/2023 A3)
3481.summary: After the monsoon period came three clear days. The peak, when the comet was closest to Earth at 71 million kilometres, or 0.47 AU (47% of the average Earth–Sun distance), was in the previous week (12 October…

content.source: Po monsunskem obdobju so sledili trije jasni dnevi. Vrhunec, ko je bil komet najbližje zemlji na 71 miljonih kilometrov, oziroma 0.47 Au (47% povprečne oddaljenosti Zemlje od Sonca) je bil v prejšnjem tednu (12. oktobra 2024). Komet se nam pa hitro oddaljuje in do konca oktobra 2024 bo oddaljen že 1.94 Au, oziroma 290 milijonov kilometrov.
content.translation: After the monsoon period came three clear days. The peak, when the comet was closest to Earth at 71 million kilometres, or 0.47 AU (47% of the average distance from Earth to the Sun), was in the previous week (12 October 2024). The comet is now moving rapidly away from us and by the end of October 2024 it will already be 1.94 AU, or 290 million kilometres, away.

content.source: Komet C/2023 A3 Tsuchinshan-ATLAS nad Postojno
content.translation: Comet C/2023 A3 Tsuchinshan-ATLAS over Postojna

content.source: V treh nočeh lovljenja kometa sem poskusil iz štirih različnih lokacij: Strmca, Zalog (Postojna), Pečna reber in Šilentabor.
content.translation: Over three nights of chasing the comet, I tried from four different locations: Strmca, Zalog (Postojna), Pečna reber and Šilentabor.

content.source: Komet je poimenovan po dveh observatorijih, ki sta ga prva opazila.
content.translation: The comet is named after the two observatories that first observed it.

content.translation: Photographed from Zalog near Postojna (St Daniel's Church)

content.source: Kometi so sestavljeni iz kamnine, ledu, ogljikovih plinov in drugih prašnih delcev, premera nekaj kilometrov do desetine kilometrov. Njihov značilen rep se pojavi, ko se komet približa Soncu in toplota povzroči sublimacijo ledu v njegovem jedru, pri čemer nastanejo plini in prah, ki se zaradi sončnega vetra razpršijo v obliki repa.
content.translation: Comets are made of rock, ice, carbon gases and other dust particles, and range from a few kilometres to tens of kilometres in diameter. Their characteristic tail appears when a comet approaches the Sun and the heat causes the ice in its nucleus to sublimate, creating gas and dust that are dispersed into a tail by the solar wind.

content.source: Tretjo noč na na Šilentaborju (na motivu je cerkev Sv. Martina) sva fotografirala skupaj z
content.translation: On the third night at Šilentabor (the subject is St Martin's Church), we photographed it together with

content.translation: Matej Blatnik

content.source: Kometi imajo dva glavna tipa repa: ionski rep, ki je sestavljen iz nabitih delcev in kaže naravnost proč od Sonca, ter prašni rep, ki je širši in bolj ukrivljen zaradi manjše hitrosti delcev.
content.translation: Comets have two main types of tail: an ion tail, which consists of charged particles and points directly away from the Sun, and a dust tail, which is wider and more curved because of the particles' lower speed.

content.source: Fotografirano iz Pečne rebri (Koča Mladika)
content.translation: Photographed from Pečna reber (Mladika Lodge)

content.source: Navedbe, da ima komet orbitalno periodo 80.000 let in da so ga nazadnje gledali Neandertalci, so verjetno napačne. Komet bo svojo pot okrog sonca, kot kažejo novi izračuni, nadaljeval izven Osončja in se ne bo vrnil.
content.translation: Claims that the comet has an orbital period of 80,000 years and was last seen by Neanderthals are probably wrong. According to new calculations, the comet will continue on its path around the Sun beyond the Solar System and will not return.

content.source: Animacija kometovega bližnjega srečanja
content.translation: Animation of the comet's close encounter

content.source: Kometi imajo zelo nepredvidljivo pot, zato je težko določiti njihov izvor in prihodnost. Srečanja z zvezdami včasih tudi ne preživijo in "izparijo".
content.translation: Comets follow very unpredictable paths, so it is difficult to determine their origin and future. Sometimes they do not survive encounters with stars and "evaporate".

content.source: Med fotografiranjem sta nastala še dva time-lapse posnetka.
content.translation: Two time-lapse sequences were also made during the photography.

3402.title: Markov Spodmol
3402.summary: With all the media coverage of Križna gora and the rising water, I remembered that I had never posted any photographs of Markov Spodmol on the blog, and that we had once turned back quite quickly…

content.source: Ob vsej tej medijski sagi Križne gore in naraščanju vode, sem se spomnil, da od Markovega Spodmola nisem objavil še nobenih fotk na blog, in da smo v enem poskusu z Ano že kar hitro obrnili, ker smo jamo obiskali v deževju in vodostaj v prvem jezerčku je bil že zelo visok.
content.translation: With all the media coverage of Križna gora and the rising water, I remembered that I had never posted any photographs of Markov Spodmol on the blog, and that Ana and I had once turned back quite quickly because we visited the cave in rainy weather and the water level in the first small lake was already very high.

content.source: V tej prvi luži vode je običajno voda visoka do kolen ali pasu in prebroditi je treba kakšnih 15 metrov. Ko smo šli pa mi notri, smo pa na tej točki že plavali in do stropa je bilo samo še kakšnih 20 do 30 centimetrov.
content.translation: In this first pool, the water is usually knee- or waist-deep and you have to wade for about 15 metres. When we went in, we were already swimming at this point and there were only about 20 to 30 centimetres left to the ceiling.

content.source: V Markovem Spodmolu v visokem vodostaju
content.translation: Inside Markov Spodmol at high water

content.source: Takratna ekipa je bila: Ana, jaz, Tim in Cyril. Z Ano sva bila v dvomih glede nadaljevanja, Tim je želel naprej - vsaj tistih 15 metrov na drugo stran, če že ne do konca, Cyril je bil ostro proti.
content.translation: The team that day was Ana, me, Tim and Cyril. Ana and I had doubts about continuing; Tim wanted to go on—at least those 15 metres to the other side, if not all the way—while Cyril was firmly against it.

content.source: Po hitrem in tehtnemu razmisleku smo sklenili, da kljub strokovnemu hidrogeološkemu znanju znotraj ekipe, ne poznamo natančne dinamike poplavljanja v Markovem spodmolu, ne vemo kako hitro je ta vodostaj narastel, če še narašča in kako hitro bo še naraščal, če bo. Zato smo stisnili rep med noge in obrnili.
content.translation: After some quick but careful thought, we decided that despite the professional hydrogeological knowledge within the team, we did not know the precise flooding dynamics in Markov Spodmol. We did not know how quickly the water had risen, whether it was still rising or how quickly it might continue to rise. So we put our tails between our legs and turned back.

content.source: Vseeno smo na poti ven naredili par fotk. To je bilo tudi edinkrat, da sem vzel v to jamo fotoaparat.
content.translation: We still took a few photographs on the way out. It was also the only time I took a camera into this cave.

content.source: V jami sem v ostalih treh obiskih bolj snemal video, kot fotografiral. Postopek in burno "debato" o odločitvi glede nadaljevanja imam tudi posneto, vendar ni za v javnost :) Lahko pokažem samo odlomek ko smo še rinili naprej.
content.translation: On my other three visits to the cave, I filmed more video than I took photographs. I also recorded the process and the heated "debate" about whether to continue, but it is not for public viewing :) I can only show an excerpt from when we were still pushing onwards.

3249.title: Cave Diver
3249.summary: Sebastjan Gantar, a cave rescuer and diver from Postojna, helped us retrieve two water loggers from Škratovka Cave, at the end of about 100 metres of passage beyond a sump. After 27 minutes…

content.source: Sebastjan Gantar, jamski reševalec in potapljač iz Postojne nam je pomagal iz jame Škratovka pobrati 2 merilca vode, ki sta bila nameščena na koncu ~100 metrov rovov pod sifonom.
content.translation: Sebastjan Gantar, a cave rescuer and diver from Postojna, helped us retrieve two water loggers from Škratovka Cave, which had been installed at the end of about 100 metres of passage beyond a sump.

content.source: Ko se je po 27 minutah vrnil na površje je poziral še za nekaj fotk.
content.translation: When he returned to the surface after 27 minutes, he also posed for a few photographs.

3143.title: Dimnice
3143.summary: The visit to Dimnice Cave had a training element, so little time remained for sightseeing, exploration and photography after we had finished ‘rescuing’ one another from the rope. We will need to return…

content.source: Obisk jame Dimnice je bil vadbeno začinjen, zato časa za samo ogledovanje, raziskovanje in fotografiranje, po tem ko smo en drugega "reševali" iz vrvi, ni veliko ostalo. Potrebno se bo vrniti z neoprenom in preplavati vodni del jame od "fačuzija" do sifona.
content.translation: The visit to Dimnice Cave had a training element, so little time remained for sightseeing, exploration and photography after we had finished "rescuing" one another from the rope. We will need to return with wetsuits and swim through the water-filled section of the cave from the "fačuzi" to the sump.

content.source: Turističen del jame je izredno kičast in kapniški, a sem spet preveč hitel, tako da kadri niso najboljši in tudi osvetlitev je slaba.
content.translation: The show-cave section is extremely ornate and full of speleothems, but once again I rushed too much, so the compositions are not the best and the lighting is poor as well.

content.translation: In three and a half months in 1886, he discovered more than a hundred caves in the area. He devoted most of his attention to water caves.

content.translation: What sparked enormous interest among later generations was Lipert Cave, which received only a passing mention by comparison and was said to be a fairly short, predominantly vertical cave. Its entrance required some digging, and the cave was said to end at an

content.source: Po Putickovih odpravah se je sled za Lipertovo jamo izgubila, kljub temu, da je Putick za seboj pustil natančne načrte in karte, ki so vsebovali lokacijo vhoda in notranjost jame. Po desetletjih brezplodnega iskanja je zaradi tega nastalo veliko mitov in legend. Ali je Putick zasul vhod v jamo? Ali se v jami nahaja zaklad?
content.translation: After Putick's expeditions, the trail to Lipert Cave was lost, even though Putick left behind precise plans and maps showing the location of the entrance and the cave's interior. Decades of fruitless searching consequently gave rise to many myths and legends. Did Putick fill in the cave entrance? Is there treasure in the cave?

content.source: Veterani društva za raziskovanje jam Ljubljana (DZRJL) že od dvajsetega stoletja dalje obračajo vsak kamen, v upanju, da bi našli vhod v Lipertovo jamo.
content.translation: Veterans of the Ljubljana Cave Exploration Society (DZRJL) have been turning over every stone since the 20th century in the hope of finding the entrance to Lipert Cave.

content.source: Leta 1936 je geograf dr. Alfred Šerko objavil zapisnik, da je Lipertova jama najdena, vendar je veselje hitro zamrlo, saj podzemeljskega toka Unice takrat še niso našli. Tudi vhodni jašek, razen lokacije, ni bil takšen, kot ga je opisal Putick. Zato se je ta najdena Lipertova jama tri leta kasneje preimenovala v Najdeno jamo.
content.translation: In 1936, the geographer Dr Alfred Šerko published a report stating that Lipert Cave had been found, but the excitement quickly faded because the underground flow of the Unica had not yet been located. Apart from its location, the entrance shaft also did not match Putick's description. Three years later, this supposedly rediscovered Lipert Cave was therefore renamed Najdena Cave.

content.source: Danes se že skoraj 8 kilometrov raziskana Najdena jama še vedno ne ujema popolnoma s Putickovimi opisi. Je nekaj podobnosti in splošno mnenje je, da je Lipertova jama verjetno res Najdena, oziroma vsaj del nje. Do odkritja vhoda Lipertove jame - ali iz površja, ali iz katere izmed dvoran v Najdeni jami - bo pa pravi odgovor ovit v tančico skrivnosti.
content.translation: Today, despite almost eight kilometres having been explored, Najdena Cave still does not fully match Putick's descriptions. There are some similarities, and the general view is that Lipert Cave probably is Najdena, or at least part of it. Until the entrance to Lipert Cave is discovered—either from the surface or from one of the chambers in Najdena Cave—the true answer will remain shrouded in mystery.

content.source: Lipertova jama med člani DZRJL še vedno buri duhove, je izgovor za vsakoletno druženje in obisk Najdene jame, njej v čast je pa Matjaž Puc - Tužak napisal tudi društveno himno - NAJ ŽIVI!
content.translation: Lipert Cave still fires the imagination of DZRJL members and provides a reason for an annual gathering and visit to Najdena Cave. Matjaž Puc—Tužak even wrote the society anthem in its honour—LONG LIVE!

content.source: Jama je skozi leta postala že tako mednarodno znana, da je ena izmed najbolj obiskanih neturističnih jam v Sloveniji. Čeprav je jama relativno zahtevna, smo v njej že srečali jamarje vseh starosti. Že kar nekaj desetletij pa v blatnih dvoranah jame nastajajo skulpture. content.translation: Over the years, the cave has become so internationally well known that it is one of the most visited non-show caves in Slovenia. Although it is relatively demanding, we have encountered cavers of all ages inside it. Sculptures have also been created in the cave's muddy chambers for several decades. One of the oldest is the life-sized Woman with Child.

3005.title: Dry Lake Cerknica – Rešeto
3005.summary: I observe Cerkniško polje from the air in every season, on average about 50 times a year, but I simply cannot take good photographs from a paraglider. I have no time, not enough free hands and cannot go exactly where…

content.source: Cerkniško polje opazujem iz zraka v vseh letnih časih v povprečju približno 50-krat na leto, vendar lepih fotografij iz padala enostavno ne morem narediti. Nimam časa, nimam dovolj prostih rok, ne morem iti točno tja, kjer bi želel. Tako da se za fotke vrnem po kopnem.
content.translation: I observe Cerkniško polje from the air in every season, on average about 50 times a year, but I simply cannot take good photographs from a paraglider. I have no time, not enough free hands and cannot go exactly where I would like. So I return by land for the photographs.

content.source: Tokrat na sporedu so bili požiralniki Rešeto v obdobju suše. Sončno / delno oblačno vreme v času zahajanja in zlate ure mi je ponudilo lepo svetlobo.
content.translation: This time the subject was the Rešeto sinkholes during a period of drought. Sunny to partly cloudy weather around sunset and the golden hour gave me beautiful light.

content.source: Ko prideš v Rešeto v sušnem obdobju, je kot da bi prišel na Mars. Vsem ribam v jezeru ni bilo prizanešeno, nekatere so pa ribiči ročno preselili v umetno zajezeno jezero na drugi strani prekopa.
content.translation: When you arrive at Rešeto during a drought, it feels as though you have landed on Mars. Not all the fish in the lake were spared, but fishermen moved some of them by hand to an artificially dammed lake on the other side of the channel.

2954.title: Zeppelin over Postojna
2954.summary: A 75-METRE ZEPPELIN ALSO FLEW LOW OVER POSTOJNA TODAY The Goodyear Blimp visited Slovenia as part of its European tour. At about 13:20 it crossed the Austrian-Slovenian border west of Maribor. Its route…

content.source: Zračno plovilo Goodyear Blimp je v sklopu svoje evropske turneje obiskalo tudi Slovenijo.
content.translation: The Goodyear Blimp visited Slovenia as part of its European tour.

content.source: Okrog 13.20 je prečkal avstrijsko-slovensko mejo, zahodno od Maribora. Pot ga je nato vodila čez Ruše, mimo Oplotnice, Zreč in Vojnika do Celja in Ljubljane, nato je zavil proti Vrhniki, mimo Postojne, čez Ajdovščino in nazadnje prečkal mejo. Ob 16.00 je pristal in prenočil na letališču v italijanski Gorici.
content.translation: At about 13:20 it crossed the Austrian-Slovenian border west of Maribor. Its route then took it over Ruše, past Oplotnica, Zreče and Vojnik to Celje and Ljubljana, before it turned towards Vrhnika, passed Postojna, crossed Ajdovščina and finally crossed the border. At 16:00 it landed and stayed overnight at the airport in Gorizia, Italy.

content.source: Zgodovina poleta je vidna na tej povezavi:
content.translation: The flight history can be seen at this link:

2933.title: Betalov Rock Shelter
2933.summary: For Statehood Day, the two of us did a quick photo shoot in Betalov spodmol to make an original, funny photograph with the Slovenian flag. We also squeezed through some narrow parts of the cave and examined…

content.source: Za dan državnosti sva naredila hitro foto akcijo v Betalovem spodmolu z namenom slikanja izvirne / smešne fotke s slovensko zastavo. Stlačila sva se tudi skozi nekatere ožine v jami in si ogledala nekaj lepih detajlov.
content.translation: For Statehood Day, the two of us did a quick photo shoot in Betalov spodmol to make an original, funny photograph with the Slovenian flag. We also squeezed through some narrow parts of the cave and examined a few beautiful details.

content.source: Ani je uspela po mojem mnenju najlepša fotka, kar se tiče svetlobe in perspektiva, saj je našla lep detajl, kjer izgleda, kot da gre moja roka izven okvirja in da je fotka v 3D.
content.translation: In my opinion, Ana took the most beautiful photograph in terms of light and perspective: she found a lovely detail where it looks as though my hand is reaching beyond the frame and the photograph is in 3D.

2860.title: Veliki Kožljek (1,240 m) – Javorniki
2860.summary: Veliki Kožljek offers one of the finest, if not the finest, viewpoints in the Javorniki. It overlooks not only the entire Postojna and Pivka basins, Nanos, Snežnik and the sea, as Mali Javornik does, but…

content.source: Veliki Kožljek ponuja eno izmed najlepših, če ne celo najlepše razgledišče v Javornikih, kjer se ne vidi samo cele Postojnske in Pivške kotline, Nanosa, Snežnika in do morja, kar se da videti tudi iz Malega Javornika, ampak nudi pogled tudi v celotno Loško dolino.
content.translation: Veliki Kožljek offers one of the finest, if not the finest, viewpoints in the Javorniki. It overlooks not only the entire Postojna and Pivka basins, Nanos, Snežnik and the sea, as Mali Javornik does, but also the whole Lož Valley.

content.source: Nahaja se cca 1 km zračne razdalje jugovzhodno od Velikega Javornika in je od njega samo 30 metrov nižji.
content.translation: It lies approximately one kilometre as the crow flies south-east of Veliki Javornik and is only 30 metres lower.

content.source: Travnat in strm vrh označuje mejni kamen iz leta 1823 z napisom "NXVII Koschleck 1823", ki je kot del Rapalske meje delil Kraljevino Italijo in Kraljevino SHS.
content.translation: The steep, grassy summit is marked by an 1823 boundary stone inscribed "NXVII Koschleck 1823" which, as part of the Rapallo border, divided the Kingdom of Italy from the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes.

content.source: Javorniški gozdovi so pa v spomladanskem času še posebej barviti, od še vedno belega Snežnika, do vseh palet rjavih, svetlo in temno zelenih krošenj, ki se v daljavi v mrču obarvajo še na modro in vijolično.
content.translation: The Javorniki forests are especially colourful in spring, from the still-white Snežnik to every shade of brown, light green and dark green in the canopy, turning blue and purple in the distant haze.

1583.title: Skednena Cave
1583.summary: Skednena Cave lies on the northern edge of Planinsko polje, between Vranja and Najdena caves. It has three entrances: two horizontal passages through which one can walk for 200 metres, and a shaft in the…

content.source: Skednena jama se nahaja na severnem robu Planinskega polja, med Vranjo in Najdeno jamo. Ima tri vhode, dva vodoravna, skozi katera se lahko sprehodi v dolžini 200 metrov, ter eno brezno v stropu. Odkrita je bila leta 1933.
content.translation: Skednena Cave lies on the northern edge of Planinsko polje, between Vranja and Najdena caves. It has three entrances: two horizontal passages through which one can walk for 200 metres, and a shaft in the ceiling. It was discovered in 1933.

1865.title: Amaurobius ferox
1865.summary: At the entrance to Škratovka Cave, the two of us found a spider with pincers (?). It was supposedly the Latin-named Amaurobius ferox, or Black lace-weaver in English. In Slovenian that would be… black weaver?

content.source: Pri vhodu v jamo škratovko sva našla pajka s kleščami (?). Naj bi šlo za pajka z latinskim imenom Amaurobius ferox, oziroma po angleško Black lace-weaver. Po slovensko bi to bilo... črni tkalec?
content.translation: At the entrance to Škratovka Cave, the two of us found a spider with pincers (?). It was supposedly the Latin-named Amaurobius ferox, or Black lace-weaver in English. In Slovenian that would be... black weaver?

1877.title: Velika Karlovica Cave
1877.summary: Velika Karlovica is a karst ponor cave on the western edge of Cerkniško polje. Water from the Cerkniščica, Stržen and most of the lake drains into it, then flows onwards through Zelške Caves as part of the…

content.source: Velika Karlovica je ponorna kraška jama na zahodnem robu Cerkniškega polja. V njo odteka voda Cerkniščice in Stržena, ter največja količina naplavljenega jezera. V jami voda teče naprej v Zelške jame in je del porečja Ljubljanice.
content.translation: Velika Karlovica is a karst ponor cave on the western edge of Cerkniško polje. Water from the Cerkniščica, Stržen and most of the lake drains into it. Inside the cave, the water flows onwards into Zelške Caves and forms part of the Ljubljanica basin.

content.source: Odkrita je bila leta 1927 in od takrat je bila raziskana že v dolžini 8 kilometrov, globoka je pa samo 12 metrov. Jama je odprta z nadzorovanim vstopom.
content.translation: It was discovered in 1927 and eight kilometres have since been explored, although it is only 12 metres deep. The cave is open with controlled access.

content.source: Vhod Velike Karlovice sem fotografiral že letos pozimi za projekt KRAS.RE.VITA, kjer bo v novem multimedijskem informacijskem centru Notranjskega parka razstavljenih tudi nekaj mojih fotografij.
content.translation: I had already photographed the entrance to Velika Karlovica that winter for the KRAS.RE.VITA project, for which some of my photographs will be displayed in the Notranjska Regional Park's new multimedia information centre.

content.source: Februarja je bilo jezero polno in vodostaj še visok, ob vhodu pa ogromno naplavljenega vejevja, tako da bi bil vstop v jamo tudi s čolnom otežen.
content.translation: In February the lake was full and the water level still high, with an enormous amount of driftwood at the entrance, so entering the cave would have been difficult even by boat.

content.source: Aprila naju je kolega
content.translation: In April, our colleague

content.source: dr. Matej Blatnik
content.translation: Dr Matej Blatnik

content.source: , ki je raziskovalec krasa na postojnskem inštitutu (IZRK), povabil na obisk jame, kajti v sklopu njegove podoktorske študije Cerkniškega polja bi rad v jamo Karlovico postavil merilec za vodo.
content.translation: , a karst researcher at the Karst Research Institute ZRC SAZU (IZRK), invited us to visit the cave because he wanted to place a water logger in Karlovica Cave as part of his postdoctoral study of Cerkniško polje.

content.source: Globoko v Veliki Karlovici tudi on še ni bil (od prve vode naprej), tako da bi ta obisk služil kot izvidnica - iskanje primernih mest za merilec, da se bo naslednjič vrnil z vso opremo.
content.translation: He had not yet been deep inside Velika Karlovica either (beyond the first water), so this visit would serve as reconnaissance to find suitable locations for the logger before he returned with all the equipment.

content.source: Najprej smo, opremljeni z neoprenom, fotoaparatom in zemljevidom, izmerili prevodnost vode pri vhodu in se že kar takoj malo namakali.
content.translation: First, equipped with wetsuits, a camera and a map, we measured the water's conductivity at the entrance and immediately got ourselves a little wet.

content.source: Notranjost vhoda je zanimiva - a ne najbolj fotogenična, ampak to ni razlog, zakaj od tam nimam nobene fotografije.
content.translation: The inside of the entrance is interesting, though not especially photogenic, but that is not why I have no photographs from there.

content.source: Ker so v preteklosti želeli regulirati poplavljenost cerkniškega polja, so v nekaterih jamah gradili jezove ter izkopavali in spreminjali struge rek. Vhod Velike Karlovice je betonsko zajezen, zato da v jamo voda počasneje odteka. Na dnu jeza je pa betonska cev, skozi katero smo vstopili v jamo.
content.translation: In the past, efforts to regulate flooding on Cerkniško polje led to dams being built in some caves and riverbeds being excavated and altered. A concrete dam at the entrance to Velika Karlovica slows the water draining into the cave. At the bottom of the dam is a concrete pipe through which we entered.

content.source: Ko sem gledal, kako gre Ana po cevi, sem ritensko hodil nazaj in stopil v luknjo, ki je nisem videl. Ko sem lovil ravnotežje, sem se opraskal po roki, tako da še nekaj časa o fotografiranju sploh nisem razmišljal.
content.translation: As I watched Ana go through the pipe, I walked backwards and stepped into a hole I had not seen. I scratched my arm while trying to regain my balance, so photography did not even cross my mind for a while.

content.source: Kokreten del jame smo tudi preplavali, zato do sifona, ki je bil naš cilj in se nahaja še malo dlje od primerno poimenovanega odseka Labirint, fotoaparata niti nisem jemal iz vodotesne zaščite (in se tudi na koncu ni izkazala za vodotesno, ampak tokrat brez posledic).
content.translation: We also swam through a substantial part of the cave, so on the way to the sump—our objective, a little beyond the aptly named Labyrinth section—I did not even take the camera out of its waterproof protection (which ultimately proved not to be waterproof, though without consequences this time).

content.source: Med plavanjem in iskanjem rovov skozi Labirint, da smo prišli do sifona smo si ogledovali primerne kadre za fotografiranje, Matej pa je vmes opravil še kakšno meritev.
content.translation: While swimming and searching for passages through the Labyrinth to reach the sump, we looked for suitable photographic compositions, and Matej took a few measurements along the way.

content.source: V enem izmed rovov smo opazili stopinje v blatu. Hitro smo začeli sklepati, da so od kakšnega sesalca. Ker je bilo kar nekaj vode vmes, smo na kakšno lisico odmislili, a odgovor na to, katera žival je stopinje pustila, smo hitro dobili, ko je Mateja prestrašila vidra. Predno sem dal opremo iz hrbta vidre že ni bilo več, stopinj se mi pa takrat tudi ni zdelo vredno fotografirati, za kar mi je zdaj malo žal.
content.translation: In one passage we noticed footprints in the mud and quickly concluded that they belonged to a mammal. With quite a lot of water in between, we ruled out something like a fox, but soon learnt which animal had left them when an otter startled Matej. By the time I had taken the equipment off my back, the otter was gone. At the time the footprints did not seem worth photographing either, which I now regret a little.

content.source: Od sifona nazaj smo malo zašli, ko smo v enem izmed rovov Labirinta med plavanjem počivali in nato odplavali v napačno smer. Prišli smo na isto mesto kot prej, a mislili smo, da se nahajamo v naslednji dvorani proti izhodu. Ko smo naredili dva kroga po Labirintu in opazili isto naplavljeno rdečo gajbo (ena izmed mnogih ogromnih smeti, ki se znajdejo v jami), smo spoznali našo napako, odplavali nazaj do počivališča (brez ustavljanja) in naprej, tokrat v pravo smer.
content.translation: On the way back from the sump, we went slightly astray after resting while swimming in one of the Labyrinth passages and then setting off in the wrong direction. We reached the same place as before but thought we were in the next chamber towards the exit. After making two circuits of the Labyrinth and seeing the same washed-in red crate—one of the many enormous pieces of rubbish that find their way into the cave—we realised our mistake, swam back to the resting place without stopping and continued, this time in the right direction.

content.source: Na poti nazaj smo se ustavili na dveh mestih za fotografiranje - v eni lepi dvorani in "pri vidrah".
content.translation: On the way back, we stopped to take photographs in two places: a beautiful chamber and "by the otters".

content.source: Že malce utrujeni (vsaj midva, Matej se je verjetno ravno ogrel) smo tokrat za nazaj našli tudi umetno narejen rov, ki povezuje še en vhod v jamo -
content.translation: Already a little tired—at least the two of us; Matej had probably only just warmed up—we also found an artificial passage on the way back that connects another entrance to the cave:

content.source: Nova Karlovica
content.translation: Nova Karlovica

content.source: Izhod iz tega rova bi nam za nekaj sto metrov zmanjšal pot do glavnega izhoda Velike Karlovice in tudi pot do avtomobila, a bi zahteval nekaj plezanja, saj je bila lestev precej visoko. Ob višjem vodostaju bi bila lažje dosegljiva. Ker je bila Ana brez neoprenskih rokavic premražena in brez moči, jaz pa z ranjeno roko, smo po neuspešnem poskusu izhoda iz Nove Karlovice, izstopili iz Velike Karlovice tam, kjer smo tudi vstopili.
content.translation: Exiting through this passage would have shortened our route to Velika Karlovica's main entrance and to the car by several hundred metres, but it required some climbing because the ladder was quite high. It would have been easier to reach at a higher water level. Ana was cold and exhausted without neoprene gloves and I had an injured arm, so after an unsuccessful attempt to leave through Nova Karlovica, we exited Velika Karlovica where we had entered.

content.source: Skupno smo prehodili in preplavali dobre 4 kilometre v jami, šli smo približno kilometer in pol v dolžino, notri smo bili pa 6 ur, kar vključuje tudi dolg proces fotografiranja, iskanja rovov in navigiranja po Labirintu. V vodi smo bili kakšno uro in pol.
content.translation: In total, we walked and swam a little over four kilometres in the cave, covering about a kilometre and a half in length. We were inside for six hours, including the lengthy process of taking photographs, finding passages and navigating the Labyrinth. We spent about an hour and a half in the water.

content.source: Vhod v Veliko Karlovico in betonski jez je fotografiral Matej Blatnik v sušnem obdobju
content.translation: Matej Blatnik photographed the entrance to Velika Karlovica and the concrete dam during a dry period

2228.title: Bokeh in Different Shapes
2228.summary: While browsing an online shop for lenses, I came across a special one. The golden, shiny and beautiful (sarcasm) brass Petzval 58 Bokeh Control lens offers different shapes of blurred background, or bokeh…

content.source: Ko sem po spletni trgovini brskal za objektivi, sem naletel na enega posebnega.
content.translation: While browsing an online shop for lenses, I came across a special one.

content.source: Zlat, sijoč in čudovit (sarkazem) objektiv iz medenine
content.translation: The golden, shiny and beautiful (sarcasm) brass lens

content.source: Petzval 58 Bokeh Control
content.translation: Petzval 58 Bokeh Control

content.source: , ponuja različne oblike zamegljenega ozadja (
content.translation: , offers different shapes of blurred background (

content.source: bokeh
content.translation: bokeh

content.source: po slovensko boke) in se mi je zdel predrag za tovrstno eksperimentiranje.
content.translation: in Slovenian) and seemed too expensive for this kind of experimentation.

content.source: Zato sem pogledal, kako deluje.
content.translation: So I looked into how it works.

content.source: Blizu nastavka ima režo, v katero se lahko vstavi priložene ploščice, te pa imajo izrezane luknje različnih oblik. Ena ploščica ima izrezano luknjo v obliki srca, drugo zvezde, in tako naprej.
content.translation: Near the mount it has a slot for the supplied plates, which have holes cut into different shapes. One plate has a heart-shaped hole, another a star, and so on.

content.source: Ker se mi je zdelo, da lahko enak efekt dosežem s katerikoli drugim objektivom, sem iz kartona izrezal luknjo v obliki srca v velikosti približno 2 cm, in s kartonom prekril lečo objektiva 50mm f/1.4, tako da je edini vir svetlobe na senzor prišel iz tiste luknje.
content.translation: Because it seemed that I could achieve the same effect with any other lens, I cut an approximately 2 cm heart-shaped hole out of cardboard and covered the 50mm f/1.4 lens with it, so that the only light reaching the sensor came through that hole.

content.source: V nekaj poskusih sem z okrasnimi lučkami dosegel zadovoljive rezultate. Rezanje s škarjami sicer ni najbolj natančno in se vsaka imperfekcija pozna, tako da sem že naročil kolegu, naj mi s CNC strojem izreže nekaj ploščic. Rezultati sledijo...
content.translation: After a few attempts, I achieved satisfactory results with decorative lights. Cutting with scissors is not especially precise and every imperfection shows, so I have already asked a colleague to cut a few plates for me with a CNC machine. Results to follow...

content.source: V zakulisju...
content.translation: Behind the scenes...

2447.title: Tandem Paragliding Flight from Javorniki and Planinska gora
2447.summary: Ana's classmate, a karst researcher at the Karst Research Institute ZRC SAZU, wanted to fly over the flooded Cerkniško polje that he studies in his postdoctoral research. His wish was not difficult to fulfil: first we…

content.source: Anin sošolec, ki je raziskovalec krasa na postojnskem inštitutu si je zaželel letenja nad poplavljenim Cerkniškim poljem, ki ga v svoji podoktorski študiji preučuje.
content.translation: Ana's classmate, a karst researcher at the Karst Research Institute ZRC SAZU, wanted to fly over the flooded Cerkniško polje that he studies in his postdoctoral research.

content.source: Želje mu ni bilo težko uresničit, najprej sva na kratko letela iz Planinske gore nad in skozi meglice do Planinskega polja, nato pa še uro in pol premraženega jadranja nad Cerkniškim jezerom.
content.translation: His wish was not difficult to fulfil. First we made a short flight from Planinska gora, above and through the wisps of mist to Planinsko polje, followed by an hour and a half of freezing soaring over Lake Cerknica.

content.source: Nastalo je tudi nekaj lepih fotk s skupnimi močmi - od Ane, ki nama je bila zemeljska podpora, in nama iz zraka, čeprav je Matej večinoma
content.translation: Working together, we also made some beautiful photographs—with Ana as our ground support, and the two of us in the air, although Matej mostly

content.source: pritiskal na sprožilec
